blocks.title: Photoperiodism
blocks.text: Photoperiodism din ki lambai mein tabdeeliyon ka woh jawab hai jo podon ko apne mahol ki mausami tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne deta hai. Sada lafzon mein, yeh din aur raat ki lambai par podon ka radd-e-amal hai.

Photoperiod ke asar ka pehla mutala 1920 mein Garner aur Allard ne kiya, jinhon ne paya ke tambaku (tobacco) ka poda sirf chhote dinon ke silsile ke baad phool deta hai. Tambaku qudrati taur par khizan mein in halaat mein phool deta hai, magar chhote dinon ka samna kara ke phool masnooi taur par bhi laye ja sakte the. Mazeed mutale se unhon ne phooldar podon ko long-day podon, jinhen phool ke liye lambe din chahiye, short-day podon, jinhen chhote din chahiye, aur day-neutral podon, jo photoperiod se qata nazar phool dete hain, mein taqseem kiya. Baad ke mutalon ne dikhaya ke asal mein andhere ke daur ki lambai faisla-kun hai: short-day pode asal mein long-night pode hain. Agar yeh chhote dinon mein ugaye jayen magar lambi raat roshni ke chhote waqfe se tori jaye to phool rukta hai; aur long-day pode chhote dinon mein phool denge agar lambi raat tori jaye.

Phytochrome, ek roshni-hassas (photoreceptor) protein, do shaklon mein hota hai, P660 aur P730. P660 khamosh (quiescent) shakal hai; yeh 660 nm par surkh roshni jazb kar ke faal P730 mein badal jata hai, jo 730 nm par door-surkh (far-red) roshni jazb kar ke wapas P660 ban jata hai. Qudrat mein P660 se P730 ki tabdeeli din ki roshni mein aur P730 se P660 ki tabdeeli andhere mein hoti hai. Jis raftar se P730 wapas P660 banta hai woh pode ko andhere ki muddat napne ki ghari (clock) deti hai.

Surkh roshni short-day podon mein phool rokti hai magar long-day podon mein un halaat mein barhati hai jin mein woh aam taur par phool dete hain. Is se yeh mafrooza bana ke P730-P660 ki bahami tabdeeli phool ke liye pode ki waqt ki muntazim ho sakti hai: surkh roshni se P660 se bana P730 short-day podon mein phool rokta aur long-day podon mein barhata hoga. Chunke P730 din mein jama hota aur raat ko ghatta hai, short-day poda sirf tab phool de sakta hai jab raat itni lambi ho ke us ka zyada tar P730 ghair-faal ho jaye, jab ke long-day pode ko phool barhane ke liye raat ke aakhir mein kafi P730 baqi chahiye. Ab aam taur par maana jata hai ke phool ka waqt mukammal taur par is bahami tabdeeli se qaboo nahin hota; roshni ki maujoodgi ya ghair-maujoodgi aur andhere aur roshni ke daur ki lambaiyan bhi aham hain. Ek baar tehreek milne par biological clock patton mein hormone florigen banwati hai, jo phloem se phool ki kaliyon tak jata aur phool shuru karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: do box, khakistari P660 aur surkh P730, P660 se P730 tak teer jis par surkh roshni 660 nm likha hai aur wapas teer jis par far-red 730 nm ya andhere mein aahista, ghari aur florigen par notes ke saath. Daen: short-day pode aur long-day pode ke liye peele din aur kaali raat ki pattiyan, jo dikhati hain ke kaun phool deta hai aur raat mein roshni ki jhalak ka asar.
blocks.caption: Phytochrome ki bahami tabdeeli aur faisla-kun raat ki lambai (is topic ke liye asal diagram; kitab mein sirf table hai).
blocks.long_description: Surkh roshni khamosh P660 ko faal P730 banati hai, aur far-red roshni ya andhere mein aahista zawal use wapas kar deta hai, to subah baqi P730 ki miqdar raat ki lambai napti hai. Cocklebur jaisa short-day (long-night) poda sirf tab phool deta hai jab raat us ki faisla-kun lambai se zyada ho, aur raat mein roshni ki jhalak ghari ko reset kar ke phool rok deti hai; henbane jaisa long-day (short-night) poda tab phool deta hai jab raat us ki faisla-kun lambai se chhoti ho, aur lambi raat torne se woh chhote dinon mein bhi phool deta hai. Tehreek-yafta ghari patton mein florigen banati hai, jo phloem mein phool ki kaliyon tak jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek kashtkar chrysanthemums ko 10 ghante ki raaton mein rakhta hai magar aadhi raat ko chand minute ke liye greenhouse ki batiyan jala deta hai. Kya woh phool denge? Phytochrome se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Chrysanthemum short-day, long-night poda hai jo sirf tab phool deta hai jab raat us ki faisla-kun lambai se zyada ho. Aadhi raat ki surkh roshni ki jhalak P660 ko wapas P730 bana kar ghari ko yun reset kar deti hai jaise do chhoti raatein guzri hon, to kafi P730 ghair-faal nahin hota aur phool ruk jata hai.

items: Photoperiodism din ki lambai par phool ka jawab hai (Garner aur Allard, 1920, tambaku). Short-day pode (cocklebur, chrysanthemum, soya bean, tambaku, strawberry) ko lambi raatein chahiye; long-day pode (henbane, snapdragon, cabbage, bahar ki gandum, bahar ka jau) ko chhoti raatein; day-neutral pode (kheera, tamatar, matar, makai, kapas) qata nazar phool dete hain. Andhere ka daur asal cheez hai.

Phytochrome: surkh roshni (660 nm) P660 ko faal P730 banati hai; far-red (730 nm) ya andhera use wapas karta hai, to P730 ka zawal raat napta hai. Surkh roshni short-day podon mein phool rokti aur long-day podon mein barhati hai. Doosre awamil bhi aham hain; tehreek-yafta ghari patton mein florigen banati hai, jo phloem mein kaliyon tak jata hai.
